<?php
class ReviewPendingThrowOld32 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewPendingThrowNew32 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function &reviewPendingThrowChild32() { global $row; $row = [new ReviewPendingThrowOld32()]; echo "C|"; yield $row; echo "L|"; return $row; }
function reviewPendingThrowMiddle32() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewPendingThrowUpper32() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewPendingThrowOuter32() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$injected = new Exception("injected32"); $child = reviewPendingThrowChild32(); $middle = reviewPendingThrowMiddle32(); $upper = reviewPendingThrowUpper32(); $outer = reviewPendingThrowOuter32();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); $held = $upper->current(); echo "H|", $held[0] instanceof ReviewPendingThrowOld32 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
try { $upper->throw($injected); echo "BAD-THROW|"; } catch (Exception $e) { echo "CALLER|", $e === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $e->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
$row[0] = new ReviewPendingThrowNew32(); echo "WRITE|", $held[0] instanceof ReviewPendingThrowOld32 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->current()[0] instanceof ReviewPendingThrowNew32 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($row); echo "ROW|"; unset($held); echo "HELD|"; echo "E";

<?php

$injected = new Exception("cell32"); $child = reviewPendingThrowCellChild32(); $middle = reviewPendingThrowCellMiddle32(); $upper = reviewPendingThrowCellUpper32(); $outer = reviewPendingThrowCellOuter32();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $middle->current() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); echo "T|";
try { $upper->throw($injected); echo "BAD-THROW|"; } catch (Exception $e) { echo "CALLER|", $e === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $e->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $upper->current() === null ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|";
$slot = new ReviewPendingThrowCellNew32(); echo "WRITE|"; unset($slot); echo "UNSET|"; echo "E";
